issues.on_page: Materials and services sold and refunds 40,152
issues.issue: Mixed label that the statement counts in Charges for services (p5/p6). The receipt line is categorized reimbursements/refunds but the matching detail line (detail[7]) has detail_category 'other charges for services', so the same line has two inconsistent categories. Charges for services/fees is probably the better fit.

This is sales tax the city collected on its own sales and passed on to the state ('Sales tax remitted' 1,655). It is counted in Charges for services on the statement, so the category can be defended, but it is a judgment call.

The Statement of Activities (p2) counts this line in Policy/administration charges for services: 45,746 + 8,059 = 53,805. The printed label says Miscellaneous, so other can be defended, but the page suggests charges for services. Same applies to detail[9].

issues.on_page: Grant income 28,230 (SoA: Operating Grants and Contributions)
issues.issue: The grantor is not printed. The user ruling says grants and donations are separate categories and a grantor must not be guessed, yet state aid assumes a government grantor. Same applies to detail[10].
The tax type is not stated. A county road tax is probably the county's property levy shared with the city, but the page does not say so. Same applies to detail[33].

The printed label is 'Community development', not the 'Community development/betterment' wording that the user's Community Betterment rule names. Economic development is also possible. Same applies to detail[44].

The Street Fund capital outlay is labelled 'Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways', but the General Fund line has no function label. The function is not printed, so this is inconsistent but cannot be confirmed.
